glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): an infant with an imperfect cranium (i.e. fontanelle).
s_page_origin: Pictogram (象形) – a standing person. A radical form of 人. Also simplified from 兒 (臼 →). In the character 亮, the standing person 儿 was corrupted into 几. Unrelated to 匹.
senses: [ní] alternative form of 齯 (“teeth grown in old age”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 兒; s_page_origin explains the simplified 儿.
